task.title: Moving forward and backward
task.shortdesc: Adjust the seat before driving. Make sure the seat is locked securely by trying to move forward and backward without using the lever. If the seat moves, it is not locked properly.

context.p: To move the seat forward or backward:

step.cmd: Pull the seat slide adjustment lever up and hold it.
Slide the seat to the position you desire.
Release the lever and make sure the seat is locked in place.

link.linktext: Front seat adjustment for manual seat
